nodes.label: Personal License Pricing
nodes.rationale: $39-49 one-time or $29/yr, modeled on TablePlus/Postico's one-time-plus-updates pricing to avoid subscription fatigue for an individual-buyer desktop tool.

nodes.label: Product & Business Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting product/UX/business/security/go-to-market view; flags that three different price numbers (entitlement_config.py, LAUNCH_PLAN.md, ai/flush-context.md) currently disagree and need reconciling into one source of truth.

nodes.label: Free vs Pro Tier Model
nodes.rationale: Free tier caps connections/tabs/history/ER-diagram size with no license or network required; Pro is a one-time unlock. Gates advanced features rather than blocking basic database operations.

nodes.label: Keyring-Only Credential Storage
nodes.rationale: Passwords stored via OS keyring only (utils/credential_store.py) with no encrypted-file fallback; if the keyring is unavailable, QForge keeps the password in connections.json in plain text and warns the user rather than silently losing it.

nodes.label: Production Safety Slices Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Six-slice recommended order: environment classification, read-only mode, dangerous-query guard, transaction controls, query limits/timeout/cancellation, audit trail. Non-negotiable principle: database permissions remain the final security authority; client guards only reduce accidents.

nodes.label: QForge App Icon
nodes.rationale: Dark rounded-square macOS app icon: a blue gradient ring shaped like the letter Q, enclosing a white database-cylinder glyph, with the ring's tail sweeping down-right to complete the Q.
